name: ssh.exec
description: Execute a non-interactive command on a remote host over OpenSSH. Reuses multiplexed SSH connections by default and honors ~/.ssh/config aliases.

command.description: Command to execute on the remote host

user.description: Optional SSH username override; normally omit when ~/.ssh/config defines it

port.description: Optional SSH port override; normally omit when ~/.ssh/config defines it

identity_file.description: Optional local SSH private-key override; normally omit when ~/.ssh/config defines it

reuse_connection.description: Reuse a multiplexed SSH master connection for subsequent calls

control_persist_seconds.description: How long an idle multiplexed master connection remains reusable

connect_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout only for establishing a new SSH connection; remote command execution itself has no timeout
